title: Collect the even numbers
description: Write a function `evens_up_to(n)` that returns a list of every even number from 0 to `n`, inclusive.
hints: Function to consider: range() with a step of 2
range(0, n + 1, 2) starts at 0 and jumps by 2 each time, landing on every even number up to and including n (when n itself is even).
expected_behavior: Returns every even number from 0 to n inclusive, ascending.
explanation: range()'s step argument does the filtering for free - stepping by 2 starting from 0 never touches an odd number, so there's no need for an `if number % 2 == 0` check inside a loop.
